title: Semiprojective Banach lattices
summary: We introduce a norm-controlled notion of semiprojectivity for Banach lattices, requiring liftability of contractive lattice homomorphisms through inductive limits of closed ideals with arbitrarily small loss of norm control. Our main result establishes that, for a compact metric space $X$, the Banach lattice $C(X)$ is semiprojective if and only if $X$ is an absolute neighbourhood retract.
